what: The letters of the two halves of the thin big-letter name rise from 110% below in 1.8s (.025s stagger). At 1.5s the zero-width box between the halves opens into a 1em photo window (1.45s) while the halves spread ±.05em apart. At 2.6s the window grows over 3s to the panel size (minus 20px margins each side) and the halves vanish in .4s — all expo.inOut. At 4.8s the white title words, tilted -12°, rise from 125% below in 1.8s (.095s stagger, expo.out)

options.gutter: Gap between the fully grown window and the panel edge (px), default 20 — the original is 16 below 1199px and 10 below 767px
options.speed: Overall speed multiplier, default 1 — 2 panels finish in 3.3s (raise it for screens that are opened often)
options.start: With wait, it doesn’t wait for fonts and opens when fx:play is sent to the element (e.g. once the first photo has fully loaded)
options.--fx-side: Width of the two-part name column, default 2.7em — font size and typeface follow the using side [data-fx-part=intro] to
options.[data-fx-part=intro] > [data-fx-part=sta: About layers — name in front, box in the middle (photo window inside), and a back layer. start and end are optional (without them only the box opens)
options.[data-fx-part=title]: Title that rises last (optional) — position and color are up to the consumer
options.fx:opened: Event fired from the element once the window has fully expanded and the title is in place
